# Clara Mendes — shopclaramendes.com

> Independent art studio shop. We like art and follow it wherever it goes.
> Twenty-four works of our own across
> seven capsules, giclée-printed to order on 200gsm Enhanced Matte Art paper
> in 8 × 10, 16 × 20, and 20 × 24 in. Around the art: museum prints of
> Hokusai and Hiroshige, greeting cards, postcards, stretched canvas, tough
> phone cases, personalised star maps, activewear, ceramic plant pots and DIY
> book nook kits. Ships to the EU and most countries; not the United Kingdom.

Key facts

- The capsule prints are our own compositions; no licensed
  stock art. Floating World reproduces public-domain works from museum
  open-access collections and credits each one.
- Prints are made to order and dispatched within 2–4 business days; delivery
  is estimated at 5–10 business days after dispatch across the EU and 7–20
  elsewhere. Canvas and framed pieces ship outside the EU to selected
  countries; cards and postcards ship within the EU only.
- United States: prints, canvas, phone cases and unframed Your Sky maps are
  estimated at 7–15 business days after dispatch.
- Other lines have their own timings and rates, shown on each product page
  and in the shipping policy: clothing is made to order (2–7 business days
  processing) with one shipping fee per order; plant pots ship untracked from
  the UK (not to the US); book nook kits ship from our fulfilment partner with
  delivery included.
- Outside the EU, import taxes and duties may be payable on delivery.
- 30-day return window from delivery for unused items; personalised orders
  and assembled kits cannot be returned. Support: hello@shopclaramendes.com,
  replies within one business day.
- Prices in EUR; secure Shopify checkout.

## Original art capsules

- [Quiet Form](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/quiet-form): warm
  architectural abstracts in ivory, oat, terracotta, and charcoal.
- [Patina Blue](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/patina-blue):
  weathered indigo and cobalt mineral-wash abstracts.
- [Neo Deco](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/neo-deco): graphic
  Deco-inspired geometry in black, oxblood, green, and muted gold.
- [Midnight Garden](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/midnight-garden):
  dark botanicals in navy, plum, teal, and copper.
- [Sunlit Mosaic](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/sunlit-mosaic):
  warm collage rhythms in terracotta, ochre, olive, and cobalt.
- [Sci-fi & Cinema](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/all?capsule=scifi-cinema):
  imagined worlds, cinematic light, and a sense of scale — four prints.
- [Light & Silence](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/all?capsule=light-and-silence):
  black-and-white nature studies of texture, light and stillness — five
  prints.

## Museum prints

- [Floating World](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/all?capsule=floating-world):
  ten Edo-period Japanese woodblock views by Hokusai and Hiroshige, each as an
  art print, framed print, stretched canvas, greeting card, postcard and tough
  phone case.
- [Artists](https://shopclaramendes.com/artists): a shop per artist, with the
  source of every work.

## Beyond the wall

- [Art for Everyday Living](https://shopclaramendes.com/collections/clara-mendes-art-living):
  the five founding capsules on greeting cards, postcards and stretched
  canvas.
- [Art Tough Phone Case](https://shopclaramendes.com/products/art-tough-phone-case):
  all twenty-four original works on a matte, dual-layer case for iPhone,
  Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel.
- [Your Sky](https://shopclaramendes.com/your-sky): a personalised star map of
  a chosen place and minute, unframed or framed.
- [Clothing](https://shopclaramendes.com/clothing): Quiet Current activewear —
  leggings, sports bra, biker shorts and tank — in two colourways, XS–XL.
- [Pastel Forms](https://shopclaramendes.com/pastel-forms): four small ceramic
  plant pots in soft pastel colours.
- [Book Nooks](https://shopclaramendes.com/book-nooks): ten DIY kits for
  miniature rooms that sit between books on a shelf.
